$comment: Static reference schema for webscrape/filters.yaml. Not read by fetch_tenders.py at runtime - this is documentation/tooling metadata (e.g. for a future editor UI, a linter, or generating filters.yaml's own header comments) describing every filter key that exists or could exist, whether it's actually wired into matches_profile() today, its type, and which OCDS field(s) it reads. Keep this in sync by hand when fetch_tenders.py's OPTIONAL_FIELD_DEFAULTS / REQUIRED_FIELDS change.

fields.description: Free text, used in output filenames/headers. Not matched against release data.
CPV code prefixes. Matches if ANY of the release's CPV codes (primary + secondary/additional classifications) starts with ANY prefix here. CPV browser: https://simap.ted.europa.eu/cpv
NUTS region-code prefixes (Germany = DE...). Matches if the tender's delivery region, buyer region, or any listed party's region starts with ANY prefix here.
Minimum contract value in EUR. null = no floor.
fields.match_semantics: hard_reject_below_min; missing/non-EUR value is ALSO a hard reject regardless of this field

fields.description: Maximum contract value in EUR. null = no ceiling.
fields.match_semantics: hard_reject_above_max; missing/non-EUR value is ALSO a hard reject regardless of this field

fields.description: Case-insensitive substrings. If ANY appear anywhere in the tender text blob, the notice is rejected outright.
Same mechanics/text blob as exclude_keywords, kept as a separate list so role-fit heuristics can be tuned independently of hard capability exclusions.
Allowed tender.procurementMethod values (case-insensitive), e.g. ["open", "restricted"]. null/unset = no filter.
fields.match_semantics: reject_if_present_and_not_in_list; lenient (skipped) if field absent on the release

fields.description: Minimum number of days between the tender submission period's start and end dates. null/unset = no filter.
If true, reject releases with a non-empty tender.otherRequirements.reservedParticipation (sheltered-workshop / social-enterprise set-asides).
fields.match_semantics: reject_if_present_and_non_empty; no effect if field absent

fields.description: Inclusive lower bound on tender.lots[].contractPeriod.startDate. Can be set alone or combined with contract_starts_before.
fields.match_semantics: reject_if_release_has_lot_contract_periods_and_none_fall_in_[after,before]_window; lenient (skipped) if no lot has a contractPeriod

fields.description: Inclusive upper bound on tender.lots[].contractPeriod.startDate. Can be set alone or combined with contract_starts_after.
fields.match_semantics: reject_if_release_has_lot_contract_periods_and_none_fall_in_[after,before]_window; lenient (skipped) if no lot has a contractPeriod

fields.description: Free text, shown in the output markdown footer. Not used for matching.
Prospective filter on lot-bidding constraints, e.g. maximumLotsBidPerSupplier. NOT PRESENT on the one sample checked so far - confirm coverage before designing the real key/shape.

Free-text submission channel (portal URL, postal, etc.). Not obviously filterable as a hard rule; more useful surfaced as context in the rendered output than as a filter. NOT PRESENT on the one sample checked.
Every organization's role(s) in the process. Not obviously a matching filter; more useful as context (e.g. confirming who actually receives submissions vs. who's just a review body).
